column1: # Slite notes pulled into context/slite/ at session start.
# ONLY list notes with no repo counterpart. Do not add 01-06 or anything in
# context/ — those are authored here and mirrored OUT to Slite. Listing them
# would load two copies of the same doc and make it ambiguous which one wins.
# Do not add anything under the business-rules tree either. That is co-authored
# with Mike in cami-feature-docs and is cited by ID, never duplicated.
# Keep this list short. Everything here is loaded into context on every single
# session, so a long reference doc costs more than it returns. Data Migration
